hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" = "$HOME/Hydra-OS" ] || exit 0; i=$(cat); r="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; f="$r/hydra/think/fence.json"; if [ -f "$r/hydra/config.json" ] && [ ! -e "$f" ]; then case "$i" in *think*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; fi; p="$HYDRA_PYTHON"; [ -x "$p" ] || p="$HOME/Hydra-OS/hydra/bin/python3"; if [ -x "$p" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" | "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/review_fence.py"; c=$?; { [ "$c" = 0 ] || [ "$c" = 2 ]; } && exit "$c"; fi; [ -e "$f" ] && { echo "During the morning review, Claude uses only hydra think and the reads it lists." >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

[ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" = "$HOME/Hydra-OS" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/hydra/think/fence.json" ] || exit 0; p="$HYDRA_PYTHON"; [ -x "$p" ] || p="$HOME/Hydra-OS/hydra/bin/python3"; [ -x "$p" ] || exit 0; exec "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/review_keep.py"

[ "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" = "$HOME/Hydra-OS" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/hydra/config.json" ] || exit 0; p="$HYDRA_PYTHON"; [ -x "$p" ] || p="$HOME/Hydra-OS/hydra/bin/python3"; [ -x "$p" ] || exit 0; exec "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_end.py"
